 WWE AAA Heroes Inmortales results, live discussion Week 3 (Nov. 7, 2026): Hall of Fame induction
 Follow along as Marisela Peña is inducted by Rey Mysterio and more!
 by Manolo Has Pizzazz Nov 8, 2026, 1:30 AM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Manolo Has Pizzazz learned all of life’s lessons from decades of professional wrestling. Manolo has been covering the sport for over ten years on Cageside Seats. Saturday night should be a glorious night… for chaos in Lucha Libre AAA (Nov. 7, 2026). Marisela Peña, the matriarch of AAA, will be inducted into the AAA Hall of Fame by Rey Mysterio. That sounds safe on the surface. However, Dorian Roldan will surely have a thing or two to say about not being chosen to induct his own mother. Plus, Roldan still has issues with Rey for interfering in Dominik Mysterio’s failed rematch against El Grande Americano for the Mega Championship. This might get as wild as a wrestling wedding, and we know how wild those can get.
 This episode was taped from Gimnasio Olímpico Juan de la Barrera in Mexico City, Mexico.
 Lucha Libre AAA airs Saturday night at 9 pm ET on FOX in Latin America as well as YouTube and Facebook everywhere else. WWE streams the show in English on YouTube. AAA offers the program in Spanish through FOX One.
 Join us for updates on results, click play above, and chat in the comments. If you’re on a mobile device, download the new SB Nation app , and follow along on your Feed or in the Game Chat section.
 WWE AAA LUCHA LIBRE HEROES INMORTALES WEEK 3 RESULTS FOR NOVEMBER 7 
 Note: Lucha Libre AAA starts at 9 pm ET now on YouTube. Mexico doesn’t participate in Daylight Saving Time, so the two-hour time difference to ET is now only one hour.
 Bravo Americano defeated Cruz Del Toro and Takuma . High-octane three-way action. Down the stretch, Rayo landed a moonsault onto the Tokyo Bad Boys. Cruz tried to cheat with Joaquin Wilde, but Wilde accidentally sprayed Cruz in the face. Bravo landed a flying splash onto Cruz for the win. The LWO bickered again after the loss.
 Psycho Clown, Mr. Iguana, and La Parka congratulated Marisela Peña for the AAA Hall of Fame.
 Pimpinela Escarlata challenged Omos to a fight. Pimpi isn’t scared. Omos started this beef, and Pimpi will end it.
 El Fiscal defeated Abismo Negro Jr. via DQ. Abismo controlled the action in the first half, then Fiscal rallied in the second half. The grudge match got out of hand. Fiscal rammed Abismo into the steel steps, then he tried to set up a tombstone onto the steps. Abismo escaped and hit Fiscal with the steps. The referee waved off the bout. Abismo assaulted Fiscal with a steel chair to the back. The rivalry rages on.
 El Fiscal, Money Machine, and El Grande Americano congratulated Marisela.
 Telenovela scandal! Marisela Peña was inducted into the AAA Hall of Fame by Rey Mysterio. Her speech was interrupted by her son. Dorian Roldan had urgent news that could not wait. He filed a complaint with the lucha libre commission. Dorian has three cases against Rey. First, Rey sent luchadores to the USA into dangerous working conditions. He blamed the injuries to Hijo de Vikingo and Mini Vikingo on Rey. Second, Rey attacked a paying fan (Omos) at Ola de Calor. Third, Rey abused his power as general manager to make sure Dominik Mysterio lost mega title matches twice to El Grande Americano. The verdict is that Rey is suspended indefinitely. Dorian continued by dissecting Rey’s thirst for power. He didn’t understand why his mother chose Rey for the induction over her own son. Dorian put the pieces together to conclude that Rey is having an affair with Marisela! ( Full details and highlights of this scene. )
 Lucha! Lucha! Lucha!
